summary: Official sources accessed 2026-10-07 confirm educator-only eligibility, school/district-email verification and workspace onboarding. The free-service period runs through June 2028, but no exact enrollment deadline is stated, so expiry_date remains null. Payment-card requirements are not stated in the loaded pages. This is workspace access, not API credits. Unlimited applies to GPT-5.1 Auto messages, not every tool or feature.
claim_steps: Start educator verification at chatgpt.com/k12-verification using your school or district email address.
After verification, create a workspace or join an existing workspace tied to your district domain.
Follow educator onboarding prompts to set your role, subjects and grade levels.

social_proof.title: A free version of ChatGPT built for teachers
social_proof.text: ChatGPT for Teachers brings the most helpful tools in ChatGPT—like unlimited messages with GPT‑5.1 Auto, search, file uploads, connectors, and image generation—into a workspace where teachers can securely work with classroom materials and student information, collaborate with colleagues, and learn from other educators.

social_proof.text: ChatGPT for Teachers is free for verified U.S. K–12 educators through **June 2028**. You are eligible if you: * Work for an **accredited U.S. K–12 school or district**, and * Are a **teacher, staff member, school leader, or district administrator**
